title: Deeply native modules
description: Battery via IOKit, volume via CoreAudio, WiFi via CoreWLAN, Bluetooth via IOBluetooth, workspaces via CoreGraphics. They're event-driven and update the instant something changes, with icons and colours that follow their state.

title: Build plugins in any language
description: A plugin reads its settings from environment variables and prints JSON. Write one in Swift, Go, shell, Python or any language you like.

title: Declarative view DSL
description: Build rich popups and menus from a tree of layout, content and interactive nodes: stacks, grids, buttons, checkboxes, toggles, progress bars, conditionals and loops over collections. Describe them in your config or in a plugin's output.

title: Themes with light/dark mode
description: Use your own palettes or the built-in themes. Define separate light and dark schemes and kantan switches automatically. Reference theme colors anywhere with simple template syntax.

title: Menu bar masking
description: Replace native system indicators (WiFi, Bluetooth, Clock, Volume and more) with fully styled kantan modules. Clicks pass through to the native indicators underneath. Their menus and actions keep working.

title: Keep things tidy
description: Collapse modules into drawers. Place groups left, right or in the notch ears. kantan detects whether each display has a notch and places the groups to fit.
